definitions.explanation: Plants cultivated for food or commercial purposes. A general term covering rice, vegetables, fruits, grains, and other farm products.

examples.japanese: ⟦{台風|たいふう}→台風：01455_taifuu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{農作物|のうさくぶつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{被害|ひがい}→被害：02572_higai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}た→出る：00513_deru⟧。
examples.english: Crops were damaged by the typhoon.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{主|おも}な→主な：21018_omona⟧{農作物|のうさくぶつ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{米|こめ}→米：01323_kome⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{大豆|だいず}→大豆：10536_daizu⟧だ。

examples.japanese: ⟦{気候変動|きこうへんどう}→気候変動：04627_kikouhendou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{影響|えいきょう}→影響：01877_eikyou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{世界中|せかいじゅう}→世界中：10171_sekaijuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{農作物|のうさくぶつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{収穫量|しゅうかくりょう}→収穫量：29470_shuukakuryou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{減少|げんしょう}している→減少する：19026_genshousuru⟧。
examples.english: Due to climate change, crop yields around the world are declining.

notes:
USAGE:
{農作物|のうさくぶつ} is a formal compound of {農|のう} (agriculture) and {作物|さくぶつ} (produce, crops). It is commonly used in news, academic, and agricultural contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {農作物|のうさくぶつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{育|そだ}てる→育てる：01235_sodateru⟧ (to grow crops)
- {農作物|のうさくぶつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{被害|ひがい}→被害：02572_higai⟧ (crop damage)
- {農作物|のうさくぶつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{収穫|しゅうかく}→収穫：03207_shuukaku⟧ (crop harvest)
- ⟦{主要|しゅよう}→主要：01649_shuyou⟧{農作物|のうさくぶつ} (major crops)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {農作物|のうさくぶつ}: crops, agricultural produce (formal, comprehensive)
- ⟦{作物|さくもつ}→作物：02823_sakumotsu⟧: crops (shorter, also common)
- ⟦{農産物|のうさんぶつ}→農産物：14360_nousanbutsu⟧: agricultural products (includes processed goods)
